description: This file defines the RefreshTokenEntity class, which implements the RefreshTokenEntityInterface for OAuth token management. It manages properties like identifier and expiry date, and references an access token. The class is part of an OAuth plugin for human resource management software.

classes.name: RefreshTokenEntity
classes.description: Represents a refresh token within the OAuth system, managing token identification, expiry, and association with an access token.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry date and time of the token.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Overrides and sets the expiry date and time to current UTC time plus the refresh token TTL.

methods.name: setAccessToken
methods.description: Associates an access token with this refresh token.
